thread:
Marisol: Heads-up — MerchantAtlas renewal hits in 10 days. Pricing approver signed off on the 12% discount but procurement says the signer matrix from onboarding doesn’t match the eSign flow we have. Need legal + payments to confirm path.
Priya: Noted. Is this the account with the delegated signer (finance lead + program manager)?
Marisol: Yes — onboarding recorded FinanceLead + PM as delegated, but procurement returned a PO that requires an executive signature (ExecCFO). They want wet signature cutouts for their EU subsidiary.
Samir: We saw that before with their vendor code. Quick check: did onboarding include KYC entity UID? If not legal will block.
Marisol: Onboarding doc has field `entity_uid: EU-ATL-3326` but the billing entity recorded in Stripe is `MerchantAtlas EU Ltd` vs their PO which shows `MerchantAtlas Global BV`.
LegalSteph: @Marisol can you drop the PO here? Also need to know whether we can accept the BV entity under current SOW. If not, we’ll need an amendment.
Marisol: Uploaded PO to thread: https://redwood-docs.internal/po/MA-PO-3326.pdf (redacted). Key lines: payment terms Net30, vendor code 9002, exec sign required.
Evan: Ops note — our eSign template currently routes to `FinanceLead` -> `ProgramManager` -> fallback `Legal` only. No ExecCFO path. We can add ExecCFO but that changes rollout and may delay signature 48–72 hrs.
Priya: Is there a workaround to close renewal without Exec signature? e.g., accept PO and then collect wet signature after 30-day access? Risky.
LegalSteph: We cannot accept PO that lists a different legal entity without an amendment signed by authorized exec of that entity. Two options: 1) amend SOW to list `MerchantAtlas Global BV` and run ExecCFO through eSign; 2) ask procurement to reissue PO for `MerchantAtlas EU Ltd` (preferred).
Samir: MerchantAtlas onboarding lead (cc’d on email) said procurement can reissue if we provide a vendor code mapping doc. I can prepare that today.
Marisol: Timeline: renewal effective date: 04/05. If procurement reissues by EOD tomorrow we can avoid amendment. If not, we need canary amendment and Exec route.
Priya: Assign tasks: Samir prepare vendor-code mapping + ask for reissue; Evan prep temp eSign path if amendment required; LegalSteph draft short amendment template and prefill entity fields. I’ll coordinate with AM for tone and comms.
Marisol: Thanks. Samir — can you post the vendor-code mapping here when ready? Also include the minimal fields procurement needs so we don’t go back and forth.
Samir: Will do. Draft snippet I’ll add: ```Vendor mapping table
- MerchantAtlas EU Ltd -> vendor_code 9001
- MerchantAtlas Global BV -> vendor_code 9002
- Preferred billing entity: MerchantAtlas EU Ltd (if PO mismatch, reissue request)
```
LegalSteph: Draft amendment checklist: what we need for ExecCFO sign-off — entity legal name, tax id, authorized signatory name + title, scanned ID, and effective dates. I’ll paste a template after this message.
Evan: If we end up routing to ExecCFO, I can add `ExecCFO` to eSign flow with a temporary override: steps = [`FinanceLead`, `ProgramManager`, `ExecCFO`]. ETA ~ 6 hours to stage and QA. Could push to prod if needed.
Marisol: Good. Priority is to avoid amendment. Priya will keep procurement tight. Please update this thread with status by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Reminder — eSign template change will trigger deploy job #deploy-4821; expect audit log entry when routed.
Priya: Quick comms text for procurement: "We can accept PO for MerchantAtlas EU Ltd (vendor_code 9001). Please reissue PO with that legal entity so we can complete renewal by 04/05 without amendment." I’ll send.
Samir: Vendor-code mapping posted and emailed to procurement. Waiting on reissue ack.
Marisol: Closing note — if reissue not confirmed by 08:00 UTC tomorrow we flip to plan B and Legal + Evan stand ready. Thanks all. :pray:
